Subject: MSA + Order Form — kickoff and initial draft

Hi Hannah / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. Attaching our current MSA (v3) and a populated Order Form for the production environment. We'd like to get Redwood’s initial redlines on the MSA and confirmation of who will sign the MSA vs. the Order Form on our side. A few specific asks from procurement/legal: 

- Confirm whether Redwood requires the MSA to be signed by the US parent entity or regional subsidiary. Our legal team prefers signing at the subsidiary level (Amplify Systems, Inc.) but can escalate if Redwood needs parent signatures.
- Confirm billing flow: PO + Net30? Our finance contact (Rajiv, cc'd) is asking whether Redwood can accept Net 30 and invoice to the Amplify corporate billing address in Austin. If not, we need to map who gets the monthly invoice.
- Exhibit B (service and SLAs): there are a couple of placeholders in the Order Form spreadsheet we haven't resolved (burst capacity, support SLAs for dedicated pools). If Redwood wants to propose alternate wording, please flag.

Attachments: Amplify_MSA_Draft_v3.docx (docx), OrderForm_Amplify_Prod.xlsx (xlsx)

We'd like an internal kickoff + first-pass redline within 5 business days if possible — are there any blocking items we should know now?

Thanks,
Alison Turner
Director, Procurement
Amplify Systems

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — kickoff and initial draft

Alison — thanks for the materials, received both attachments. Quick intake from our side and proposed next steps: 

1) Party & signatory confirmation (action: Alison/Rajiv) — We need the exact legal entity name for the MSA signature block, full printed name and title of the proposed signer, and whether Amplify expects the Order Form to be countersigned by the same person or a delegated billing approver. If you can confirm by EOD Monday that will help speed things up.

2) Billing & payment terms (action: Rajiv) — Net30 is standard for enterprise customers; we will confirm acceptance and whether any PO reference needs to be on invoice line items. Please provide billing address and AP contact email so we can map the invoice flow.

3) Exhibit B / capacity placeholders (internal action: Kimberly) — Kimberly, can you run a gap analysis between the Amplify Order Form capacities and our Dedicated pricing table? Flag any SLA conflicts — I expect we may need to propose a capped burst policy and clarify the support SLO (response vs. resolution).

4) Timeline & redline owner — Kimberly will own first-pass redline (legal), Marissa will review pricing and commercial terms (pricing exceptions, discounts). I will coordinate the DocuSign envelope and gather SOC2 artifact links if Amplify needs them. Proposed internal due dates: first-pass redline by Friday 11/26, pricing review by 11/29, and a consolidated response to Amplify by 11/30.

5) Attachments / reference links — I'll drop a party-sheet template into the Drive link below; please fill in as much as you can.

Does that plan work? If there are items that must be escalated (e.g., we cannot accept subsidiary-only signature), call that out now and we will loop in legal leadership.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Contracting
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Party_Sheet_Template.docx (to be uploaded)
